row:
Hi and welcome to my channel! 
My name is Avani. I am a licensed massage therapist who loves to find beauty in the unordinary. My husband Fish and I are newly married and together we have self converted a 2001 international school bus into our very first tiny home where we will be living full time on a farm! 

I plan to upload weekly and here you can find documentation of our tiny home journey, trying to start a family, gardening & cooking videos, and just our everyday life! Subscribe to my channel and follow along on this journey I call life! 


Follow me on instagram @avanisavage and subscribe!
